correctness.rationale: A six-leaf rooted full binary tree is represented by its proper nonsingleton leaf clusters; triplet ab|c holds iff a cluster contains a,b but not c. Recursive splits and independently inserted leaf generation agree on 945 distinct trees/concept response vectors. Explicit four-query support realizes 16 patterns; exhaustive symmetry-reduced increasing-index search finds no shattered five-query support. An explicit depth-nine full binary query certificate supplies 511 internal queries and 512 distinct correct leaf witnesses, and 945<1024 forbids depth ten. Exact smaller-case recurrences and all finite checks were replayed successfully from final scientific artifacts. No larger-leaf generalization is asserted.

originality.rationale: The closest full text, Avdiukhin et al. (2023), determines the multiclass Natarajan dimension n-2 and multiclass Littlestone growth Theta(n log n) for rooted triplet orientations, but does not give the exact six-leaf Boolean one-vs-rest dimensions (4,9). The negative response to a Boolean triplet test permits either alternative orientation, unlike the specified alternative label in the multiclass Littlestone/Natarajan formulations. Harvey et al. (2024) solve different rooted-triplet compatibility decision problems; Semple and Toft (2020) prove encoding uniqueness. Distinct adjacent 2026 quartet results do not dominate this exact Boolean calculation. Actual published-finding corpus searches yielded no equivalent claim, but absence of a database match is not a novelty proof.

value.rationale: Rooted triplets are minimal local constraints for learning labeled phylogenetic trees, and the one-vs-rest Boolean query is a natural observable distinct from established multiclass models. The sharp six-leaf exact ranks (4,9) yield a nontrivial gap of five and show saturation of the information bound with only 945 concepts; this is a motivated precise benchmark rather than a routine cardinality calculation. The exhaustive no-five-query result and complete 512-witness online construction are both needed.
